GoHighLevel Conversation AI

AI chatbot with live handover

A branded AI assistant for G92 Studios, a leather jacket manufacturer. It greets visitors, answers questions and drives qualified leads to the booking calendar.

  • Introduces the business and asks how it can help
  • Actions enabled: appointment booking, stop bot, human handover and transfer bot
  • Bot goal: qualify leads and send them to book a consultation

GoHighLevel workflows

Lead capture and follow-up system

A five-workflow lead journey for G92 Studios that tags, assigns and follows up every new enquiry without manual steps.

  • Workflows: New Leads, Nurture, Booking Confirmed, No-Show, Not Interested / Closed
  • New Leads adds a tag, creates an opportunity, assigns a user, notifies the team, waits one minute and emails the customer
  • Assigned team member gets an instant email with the lead details and the next action

GoHighLevel, Facebook and Instagram

Social comment triggers

Comments on Facebook and Instagram posts start their own workflows, so interested people enter the lead journey and DM sequence instead of being missed.

  • Separate comment-box workflows for Facebook and Instagram
  • Automated DM sequence after the trigger
  • Chatbot qualification and booking follow on from the conversation

GoHighLevel calendar and workflows

Real-time booking system

A 30-minute consultation calendar with instant confirmation, reminders and team alerts, plus a separate workflow for no-shows.

  • Visitors pick a date and time in their own time zone, then enter their details
  • Confirmation email with date, time and what to prepare
  • Booking Confirmed workflow sends reminder emails and an internal notification
  • Assign User step routes each lead to the right team member

GoHighLevel funnel builder

ClickMate Solutions funnel

A dark, conversion-focused landing page for a product photography and video studio, built to turn visitors into booked shoots.

  • Hero with two calls to action: Book Your Product Shoot and Get Free Strategy Call
  • Service cards for ad creative, product photography and product videography
  • Four-step process section from strategy to delivery

GoHighLevel email automation

Seven-day outreach engine

An outreach workflow with an approval step, editable emails, timed follow-ups and reply handling. Designed with a manual email fallback.

  • Contacts enter through an outreach-ready tag and eligibility checks
  • Seven emails with one-day waits between follow-ups
  • Replies get routed, tagged, assigned and turned into follow-up tasks
  • Setup covers sender identity, deliverability, unsubscribe and bounce suppression
Enrollment tag›Eligibility check›Approval step›Email 1›Wait 1 day›Email 2›…›Email 7
Reply received›Reply routing›Status tag›Notify assigned user›Follow-up task

n8n and AI automation

n8n, OpenAI, Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack

AI Executive Assistant

Important emails get buried and deadlines get missed. This workflow reads the inbox and the day's calendar, then posts a prioritized action digest to Slack every day.

  • Scans important Gmail messages and reads today's Google Calendar events
  • Identifies urgent tasks and deadlines and ranks them by importance
  • Highlights potential risks and writes an AI executive summary with OpenAI
  • Delivers the daily digest to Slack: summary, top priorities, source, deadline and next action

n8n, OpenAI, Meta platform, Google Sheets

Instagram AI chatbot

An Instagram assistant that replies to DMs instantly, collects lead details and saves them to Google Sheets. Tested live in Instagram DMs.

  • Collects name, business type, phone, email and required service
  • Remembers the conversation for natural replies
  • Explains services such as chatbots, lead generation and email marketing agents
  • Runs 24/7 without human supervision

n8n, OpenAI, Supabase, Google Workspace

Smart AI automation system

An AI agent that answers from company data, books and updates calendar events, keeps a sheet clean and emails customers.

  • Retrieves company data from Supabase with OpenAI embeddings for accurate replies
  • Creates, updates and deletes Google Calendar events in real time
  • Appends or updates rows in Google Sheets without duplicates
  • Sends instant automated emails

User onboarding automation

A form submission creates a new user across the company tools and applies the right access.

  • Creates the user in Google Workspace
  • Checks the role and assigns Jira Admin or Member access
  • Creates the Slack user and updates the profile

n8n, Slack, Google Sheets, Gmail

Approval and notification automation

Requests and documents are approved in Slack, logged automatically and answered by email.

  • Starts from a new Drive document or form submission
  • Sends an approval request in Slack and checks the answer
  • Approved requests are logged in Google Sheets with a confirmation email; others get feedback
  • Gives faster approvals and an accurate record
